messages.subject: Error using SPDEToy, following example from Blangardio and Cameletti text, p.206
parts:
So, I'm trying to get inla to generate a model using a gaussian random field and it won't even converge on sample data within the INLA package.

Here is my reprex and output:
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

> data("SPDEtoy")
> coords=as.matrix(SPDEtoy[,1:2])
> domain=matrix(cbind(c(0,1,1,0.7,0),c(0,0,0.7,1,1)),ncol=2)
> mesh6=inla.mesh.2d(loc.domain=domain,max.edge=c(0.04,0.2),cutoff=0.05,offset=c(0.1,0.4))
> A.est6<-inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh6,loc=coords)
> spde<-inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh6,alpha=2)
> fomrula<- y ~ -1 + intercept + f(spatial.field, model=spde)
> output6<- inla(formula,
+                data=list(y=SPDEtoy$y,intercept=rep(1,spde$n.spde),spatial.field=1:spde$n.spde),control.predictor = list(A=A.est6,compute=T))
